links.outcome: Cardiologist preference and accuracy grading of GPT-4 versus human expert answers to the same questions
links.effect: GPT-4 better in 132/251 (52.6%) vs human expert better in 119/251 (47.4%); humans had more high-accuracy (21.1% vs 12.6%) and more low-accuracy responses (4.6% vs 0.4%; P=.001).
links.quote: GPT-4 and human experts displayed comparable efficacy in medical accuracy ("GPT-4 is better" at 132/251, 52.6% vs "Human expert is better" at 119/251, 47.4%).

screen.reason: The study empirically compares GPT-4 generated medical advice with human expert responses on retrospective user queries evaluated by cardiologists, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
